claim: A linear hidden-state probe predicts CoT trace correctness at 0.95 AUROC, far above verbalized confidence (0.67), self-consistency (0.82), and CCS (0.72), on math reasoning.
stance_target: L2 probe-beats-verbal pattern generalizes outside code (math) and outside non-reasoning models
scope_conditions: MATH-500 (100 train, 200 held-out); nine models 1.5B-72B; Sec 3, Tables 1-2
quoted_support: A linear probe on hidden states predicts trace correctness with 0.95 AUROC—from the very first reasoning step (0.79)—while verbalized confidence for wrong traces is 4.55/5, nearly identical to correct ones (4.87/5).

breadth.confidence_families: hidden-state linear probe; verbalized 1-5 confidence; self-consistency N=5; CCS; text-surface classifier (Table 2)

breadth.elicitation_formats: verbalized 1-5 scale; CoT trace hidden states at last token (Sec 3.1)
breadth.benchmarks: MATH-500 (100 train, 200 held-out eval) (Sec 3.1, Table 1); no code

claim: Four causal interventions (activation steering, probe-guided best-of-N, self-correction, activation patching) fail to improve accuracy; the probe signal is diagnostic, not causal.
stance_target: L2: causal-intervention component for probes is occupied in math, not code
quoted_support: Four interventions—activation steering, probe-guided best-of-N, self-correction, and activation patching—all fail; patching destroys output coherence entirely.

claim: Probe AUROC is non-monotone in model scale (Qwen2.5-7B CV 0.669, 14B 0.762, 32B 0.956, 72B 0.977) and holds for an RL-distilled reasoning model (DS-R1-7B eval 0.852).
stance_target: Reasoning vs non-reasoning probe contrast has an occupant in math
quoted_support: The RL-distilled reasoning model DeepSeek-R1-7B also shows strong hidden error awareness (0.852), despite 76% base accuracy.
